Cofounded amo (bump app), leading mobile & recruitment. Early Zenly employee pre-Snap acquisition, leading the map effort, from engineering to experience, creating many unique interaction pattern. Shipped a cross-platform C++ map engine made from scratch: https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/18/social-maps-app-zenly-rolls-out-its-own-maps/

founders.name: Jonathan Li
founders.bio: Founder of Quippy. Most recently Head of Product at Luvu (a16z-backed), scaling from $0 to $1.5M ARR in 4 months. Previously APM at Duolingo, delivering $50.4M in ARR growth and helped build features including Video Call with Lily and Duolingo's first monolingual English course (280K DAUs in 4 months). Dual degree in CS and Business from the University of Michigan.
